verses: Jab aasman phat jaye ga
Aur apney rab kay hukum per kaan lagaye ga aur ussi kay laeeq woh hai
Aur jab zamin (khench ker) phela di jaye gi
Aur uss mein jo hai ussay woh ugal dey gi aur khali ho jaye gi
Aur apney rab kay hukum per kaan lagaye gi aur ussi kay laeeq woh hai
Aey insan! to apney rab say milney tak yeh koshish aur tamam kaam aur mehnatein kerkay uss say mulaqat kerney wala hai
To (uss waqt) jiss shakhs kay dahanay hath mein aemaal nama diya jaye ga
Uss ka hisab to bari aasani say liya jaye ga
Aur woh apney ahl ki taraf hansi khushi lot aaye ga
Haan jiss shakhs ka aemaal nama uss ki peeth kay peechay say diya jaye ga
To woh maut ko bulanay lagay ga
Aur bharakti hui jahannum mein dakhil hoga
Yeh shakhs apney mutalaqqeen mein (duniya mein) khush tha
Uss ka khayal tha kay Allah ki taraf lot ker hi na jaye ga
Kiyon nahi, halankay uss ka rab ussay bakhoobi dekh raha tha
Mujhay shafaq ki qasam! aur raat ki
Aur uss ki jama kerdah cheezon ki qasam
Aur chand ki jab kay woh kamil ho jata hai
Yaqeenan tum aik halat say doosri halat per phoncho gay
Unhen kiya ho gaya kay eman nahi latay
Aur jab unn kay pass Quran parha jata hai to sajdah nahi kertay
Balkay)yeh jinhon ney kufur kiya woh jhutla rahey hain
Aur Allah Taalaa khoob janta hai jo kuch yeh dilon mein rakhtay hain
Unhen alamnaak azabon ki khushkhabri suna do
Haan eman walon aur nek aemaal walon ko bey shumar aur na khatam honey wala ajar hai
